messages:
Harper: FYI: noticed a cluster of tenants showing negative per-token unit cost in the console after cache/prefetch credits land. PMs pinging support. :grimacing:
Rico: saw it too on /v1/chat/generate around 03:00 UTC. looks like amortized prefetch credits + late refund/eviction events flipping net numbers.
Lin: quick staging repro:
```
curl -X POST https://staging.api.redwood/econ/sim -d '{"route":"/v1/chat/generate","chain":["edge","generator"],"prefetch":true,"evict_window":180}'
```
Lin: root cause sketch: we amortize prefetch credits to the first-owner, then when a deferred cache hit is applied we record a refund event that ends up double-counting for small sessions. result: adjusted/net_cost < 0.
Priya: UX ask from PMs: can we show "gross token cost" vs "net after credits" side-by-side and avoid showing raw negative numbers without context? customers freak out seeing -$0.01/token.
Harper: proposal: dashboard columns = gross_token_cost, amortized_prefetch_credit, net_cost. default to net_cost but if net_cost < 0 show a subtle warning chip with "why negative?" that expands to an explainer. add a per-route toggle "exclude amortized prefetch credits".
Rico: data change requirement: we need traceable credit lineage. suggest optional fields on econ.events: credit_amount (number), credit_source (enum: prefetch|evict_refund|manual), lineage_id (short hex). keep optional to limit cardinality.
Lin: sampling plan to control cardinality: deterministic sampling by tenant_id (default 2%), 100% capture for canaries and paid tiers; sampled events include full lineage payload. non-sampled emit only aggregate numbers.
Priya: console work: expose an API that returns both gross_series and net_series for a route and wire the toggle. also add a CTA "show sampled traces" when lineage_id exists that fetches sampled traces for that hash. i'll mock the UI and help copy.
Harper: operational rule: exclude canary traffic from amortized pools (treat canaries as cold) so experiments don't skew tenant economics. also add an alert: route 95p net_cost < 0 for > 10m -> send to econ-oncall in dry-run first.
Rico: storage note: lineage_id should be short (8-char hex) and credit_source an enum to keep cardinality bounded. i'll run estimates for 2% sampling and post numbers.
Lin: action items: (1) Lin -> schema PR adding optional credit_amount, credit_source, lineage_id + migration notes. (2) Rico -> sampling rollout + storage estimates + deterministic sampler keyed by tenant. (3) Priya -> console toggle + API contract + mock. (4) Harper -> RFC to exclude canaries from amortization and alert dry-run checklist.
econ-bot: econ-service v2.14.9 deployed to staging (hash: e4a1b2c)
Harper: thanks all 12 let's sync in 30 to review PRs and the mock. :thumbsup:
